note: This scaffolding describes only the changes and additions relative to Sprint01. Existing files not listed here are retained unchanged unless noted.

files_changed.change: Update init_schema() to run all .sql files in migrations/ directory sorted by filename, instead of hardcoding 001_init.sql. Replace the hardcoded sql_path assignment with a sorted glob: sorted(_MIGRATIONS_DIR.glob('*.sql')). Execute each file in a separate transaction in order.
Add two new Pydantic models: CalendarCreateEventRequest and CalendarCreateEventResult. Retain existing CalendarEventRow and CalendarConnectionStatusRow unchanged.

fields.note: ISO8601 string as returned by Google

files_changed.change: Update _CALENDAR_SCOPE constant from 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.readonly' to 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar'. No other changes to this file.
Add create_event() function. Retain existing fetch_events() and _normalize_event() unchanged.

new_functions.name: create_event
new_functions.signature: create_event(access_token: str, target_calendar_id: str, request: CalendarCreateEventRequest) -> CalendarCreateEventResult
new_functions.description: POST to Google Calendar API v3 events.insert for the given calendarId. If all_day=True, use date-only format (YYYY-MM-DD) for start and end. If all_day=False or absent, use dateTime format. Returns CalendarCreateEventResult on success. Raises ValueError on non-2xx response from Google.
new_functions.response_normalization: Extract id, summary, start, end, organizer.displayName from Google response. Determine all_day from presence of date vs dateTime in start object.

files_changed.change: Add write_decision_log() function. Retain all existing functions unchanged.

new_functions.name: write_decision_log
new_functions.signature: write_decision_log(conn, operation: str, requested_at: str, target_calendar_id: str, outcome: str, google_event_id: Optional[str], error_summary: Optional[str]) -> None
new_functions.description: Insert a row into calendar_decision_log. Commits immediately. Does not raise — callers should wrap in try/except to implement best-effort semantics.
new_functions.note: Caller is responsible for best-effort wrapping (try/except in router layer).

files_changed.change: Add POST /api/calendar/events endpoint. Add _target_calendar_id() helper function. Retain all existing endpoints unchanged.

new_functions.name: _target_calendar_id
new_functions.description: Read CALENDAR_TARGET_CALENDAR_ID from environment. Raise RuntimeError if absent (fail-fast — called at startup validation, not inline per-request).
new_functions.note: Should be called once at startup to validate presence, then cached or re-read per request.

new_functions.name: create_event endpoint
new_functions.response: JSONResponse(status_code=201, content=CalendarCreateEventResult.model_dump()) on success | JSONResponse api_error on failure
flow: 1. Read connection record; return NO_CALENDAR_CONNECTION if absent
2. Read token; perform refresh check (reuse existing pattern from get_events)
3. Check granted_scopes includes write scope; return INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE if not
4. Resolve target_calendar_id from env var CALENDAR_TARGET_CALENDAR_ID
6. On success: write success decision log entry (best-effort try/except); return 201 JSONResponse with CalendarCreateEventResult
7. On ValueError from create_event: write failure decision log entry (best-effort try/except); return api_error(code='GOOGLE_API_ERROR', status=502)
8. On Pydantic validation error (missing required fields): FastAPI handles automatically with 422; no decision log write needed for input validation failures

files_added.description: Adds calendar_decision_log table. Uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency. Wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT transaction consistent with 001_init.sql.

config_changes.change: Add CALENDAR_TARGET_CALENDAR_ID=<chronos-google-calendar-id> to the Platform: CalendarConnector section. Value is operator-supplied (retrieve from Google Calendar settings for the dedicated Chronos calendar).
config_changes.note: Service will not start without this value.

deployment_preconditions: Re-run GET /api/calendar/google/connect/start after deployment to upgrade OAuth scope

scope_invariant_check.description: The INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE check in create_event endpoint must verify that the stored granted_scopes value contains the write-capable scope string.
scope_invariant_check.implementation_note: Check: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar' in (connection['granted_scopes'] or ''). This string is present in the Google-returned scope for calendar write access. calendar.readonly scope does NOT contain this substring.
scope_invariant_check.edge_case: Google may return scopes space-separated in any order. Use substring containment check, not exact equality.
